Hi Priyanka / Caldera team,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to get the POC started. I want to propose two short coordinating sessions before the hands-on:

1) POC kickoff (30–45m): introductions, success criteria, calendar of hands-on labs. Agenda: prompt review, routing policy options (hosted vs dedicated), and load-test targets.
2) Capacity planning deep-dive (30m): token budgets, rate limits, quota bump process (trial vs dedicated), and any infra constraints.

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed 24 Mar — 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Thu 25 Mar — 09:30–10:15 or 15:00–15:45

If those don't work, please suggest 2 alternative slots.

Prep items (attached / links):
- POC_Runbook_v1.pdf (attached) — has the suggested hands-on flow and required artifacts.
- env_requirements_caldera.csv — please fill the env details (network, IP allowlist, sample prompt set).
- We also included a rate_limit_template.xlsx you can use to sketch desired concurrency and TPS.

For context on capacity: for Hosted trials we can generally bump token quotas within 24–48h for reasonable trial volumes; Dedicated requires capacity commit and typically 1–2 weeks provisioning. If you can share expected concurrent users and average prompt length (tokens), we can propose a target config.

Quick ask: can you share an estimate of daily token volume and whether PHI is expected in the prompts? That will help with routing/privacy guidance.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marcus (runtime & load testing) to propose detailed defaults.

Best,

Thanks Priyanka / Olga — Marcus here (runtime team). A few operational notes so the kickoff is productive:

- For ~500k–1.2M tokens/day and ~60 concurrent sessions, recommended starting config: Hosted trial with a temporary quota bump + staging Dedicated candidate if you need predictable sustained throughput. Hosted will be fastest to start.
- Suggested initial rate limit defaults for the hands-on: 120 tps / 60 concurrent requests per customer pool. We can lower latency tail by enabling KV prefix caching for repeated prompts.
- Load-test plan: 1) smoke at 10% expected load, 2) ramp to 100% over 30 minutes, 3) sustained 2 hours. Please mark which prompts are latched vs ephemeral in the CSV so we can calibrate cache effectiveness.

We can take the deep capacity discussion in a separate 30m. I can do Fri 26 Mar 09:30–10:00 PST or Thu 25 Mar 16:00–16:30 PST. If you prefer both topics on Thu 25 Mar 15:00–15:45, I’ll be on the call and we’ll triage follow-ups asynchronously.

Dylan — I’ll ask you to prepare the load-test harness and a sample script to run against the trial endpoint.

—Marcus
